description: The import-export logistics public-private data sharing platform of Korea's Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries gathers public data and private data from shipping lines, container terminals, carriers and forwarders to reduce information asymmetry in maritime logistics, which carries 99.7 percent of Korea's import and export freight. Its services cover ship and port operation monitoring (vessel AIS information and shipping codes), integrated management of dangerous goods (IMDG and UN information with self-verification) and information sharing (ship schedules and port terminal information), collected with standard interfaces and offered through Open APIs. Coverage is national (Korean ports and shipping). Access needs a user account created on the platform; fees and a licence are not stated on the pages read. Caveats: much of the data comes from private participants and access to it depends on the platform's rules. It supports port and supply chain disruption analysis, digital twins of port logistics and monitoring of dangerous goods flows. It complements the Korean port information data and is related to the IATA ONE Record standard for air cargo.
